title: Describing Trends: növekvő tendenciát mutat, teret hódít

sections.title: Discourse on Societal Shifts
sections.content: Three phrases for talking about trends. *Növekvő tendenciát mutat* ('shows a growing trend'): *növekvő* is a present participle in *-ó/-ő*, which you know from B1 Unit 11. *Teret hódít* ('gains ground') is used for an idea or habit that spreads, often with *egyre nagyobb* ('ever bigger'). *Háttérbe szorul* ('is pushed into the background') is used for something that loses importance.

items.spanish: A megújuló energiaforrások használata egyre nagyobb teret hódít.
items.english: The use of renewable energy sources is gaining ever greater ground.

items.spanish: A hagyományos szokások egy része sajnos háttérbe szorult a városokban.
items.english: A portion of traditional customs has unfortunately been relegated to the background in cities.
